basis.scope: External autonomous scientific-research agents and their evaluation suites, as required by issue #588 Phase 0 and Phase 1. Bounded to systems and benchmarks with a retrievable primary anchor (arXiv entry, proceedings entry, or public repository) reachable from open web search as of the freshness cutoff.

rounds.note: Confirmed five of the six anchors named in issue #588 and discovered ResearchClawBench, which the issue did not list. Growth is strongly non-flat.

rounds.route_family: class-D self-improving systems, surveys, reproducibility studies
rounds.note: Located the verification-gap survey and the NeurIPS-2026 shadow-evaluation case study that issue #588 gestured at without identifiers. Both supply negative evidence and named failure modes. Growth non-flat.

rounds.route_family: retrieval/deep-research comparators, cost-controlled evaluation infrastructure, evaluator-validity critique
rounds.note: Found the cost-controlled harness infrastructure (HAL) that the issue's Phase 4 matched-arm design needs but did not name. Growth non-flat; the landscape is still producing new instruments on every route.

open_residuals.statement: Only three sources were read at primary-abstract depth (ResearchClawBench, the verification-gap survey, the open-ended-research case studies). Every other registry entry rests on search snippets, so most architecture fields are recorded CANNOT_CHECK.
open_residuals.closure_action: Read primary full text for each registered system and upgrade evidence_grade; architecture fields may only be filled from primary sources.

open_residuals.statement: Three consecutive rounds all produced substantive growth. No flat round has been observed, so bounded saturation is not established and the registry must not be cited as a complete landscape.
open_residuals.closure_action: Continue route-family rounds until two consecutive substantively flat rounds occur under the frozen basis.

open_residuals.statement: The operator-order perturbation audit, omission audit and nearest-work audit required by the saturation schema have not been performed for any round.
open_residuals.closure_action: Run expand-then-consolidate versus consolidate-then-expand on the registry build and record the substantive difference vector.

open_residuals.statement: Two anchors carry a flagged disagreement between the arXiv identifier period and the reported submission date, and issue #588 dates ScienceAgentBench to Apr 2026 while its primary anchor is arXiv 2410.05080 (ICLR'25).
open_residuals.closure_action: Resolve each flagged anchor against the publisher record before the version freeze is used for any Tier 1 comparison.

open_residuals.statement: ResearchClawBench's strongest reported agent is Claude Code, which is the harness ORION itself runs on. Any ORION result on that suite is a same-substrate comparison and cannot be reported as an independent architecture arm.
open_residuals.closure_action: Record substrate identity on every evaluation receipt and classify such comparisons SYSTEM_LEVEL_ONLY.
